prompt: Look around. Notice five things you can see.
hint: A colour, a shape, light on a wall, the sky, your own hands.

prompt: Notice four things you can feel.
hint: Your feet on the floor, the chair under you, air on your skin, your clothes.
Near or far: a fan, traffic, birds, your own breath.

prompt: Notice two things you can smell.
hint: If nothing comes, imagine a favourite smell — chai, rain on soil, incense.

prompt: Notice one thing you can taste.
hint: Or simply take a slow sip of water.
